name: Obsidian Shelf
author: tmn73
description: Lists from your Obsidian vault in the bar: links to read later, checklists, boards with dates and reminders, and notes by section, captured on your phone and handled from the desktop.

barWidget.description: Links to read later, checklists, Kanban boards and notes from a Markdown vault. Open, tick, move, date, add and clear them without opening Obsidian.

schema.label: Vault folder
schema.description: The folder that holds your lists, usually your Obsidian vault.

schema.label: Sync check command
schema.description: Optional. A shell command that exits 0 while your sync works. The chip shows a dot when it fails.

schema.label: Guide the Obsidian Sync setup
schema.description: Show the steps to keep the vault in sync with Obsidian Headless while the Obsidian app is closed.

schema.label: Tweet previews (fxtwitter.com)
schema.description: Show the author picture and the first photo of saved tweets. The plugin asks api.fxtwitter.com once per tweet, so that service sees the tweet links you save.

schema.label: Link previews
schema.description: For a saved link without a picture or a title, read the page once and use its preview image and title. Only the site itself sees the request.

schema.label: Morning summary time
schema.description: When the board summary rings each day, as HH:MM. It lists the cards due today without a time and the late cards.

schema.label: Reminder sound
schema.description: Play a sound when a card is due and with the morning summary.

schema.label: Reminder sound file
schema.description: A sound from the system sound themes. Empty: the alarm sound of the freedesktop theme.
